summary: Retest of fixes since iter 111 PASSED. All 17 sub-assertions green. Day Detail modal correctly auto-opens on /calendar?date=2025-05-13 with title 'Tuesday', showing Threshold Climb card (with View workout button testID=day-detail-view) and Mobility Flow FB50 card, plus 'Add a workout to this day' (day-detail-add) and close (day-detail-close) controls — all present and functional. All 7 DAY READINESS rings render (score 80 Good) on open weeks confirming the readiness null-guard + backend _free_calendar_week readiness/summary/tip emission fix. Empty + tiles show for FOCUS row ('Open' cells) and 28 add-session slots across the 4 empty rows (TRAINING / STRENGTH&MOBILITY / RECOVERY / SCHEDULED BY YOU). WEEK SUMMARY shows 0/0 · 0h 00m · 0 TSS as expected. NOTE: /plan and /workout-list add-to-day round trip flows were not re-tested this iteration (already covered in iter 111 and no changes to those files reported); primary retest scope (Day Detail modal fix + week-nav crash regression) fully validated.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Auth persists across in-app SPA navigation but NOT across page.goto() to protected routes after login (auth guard redirects). Pattern that works: login via 'Sign in with email' → fill 2 inputs → page.get_by_text('Sign in', exact=True).last.click(force=True) → wait 7s → then use page.evaluate("window.history.pushState({}, '', '/calendar?date=YYYY-MM-DD'); window.dispatchEvent(new PopStateEvent('popstate'));") to navigate. Nav testIDs on /calendar: prev-week, next-week, today-btn, date-range, week-dd. Day headers: day-head-0..6 (Mon=0). Day Detail modal: day-detail (root), day-detail-close, day-detail-view (cycling), day-detail-add, day-detail-supp-0/1, day-detail-scheduled-<id>. Landscape viewport 1280x900 confirmed to render tablet layout (compact=false at width>=720).
